Rugby Coach Rassie Erasmus Receives Six-Match Ban

Springbok coach Rassie Erasmus has been suspended for six matches following his criticism of the Television Match Official (TMO). The ban was imposed after Erasmus made remarks described as an 'unacceptable attack' and related to 'match-fixing' slurs.
